I received the FISP coupon this year, so I will apply the subsidized NPK and urea bags on this maize plot. I am planting the hybrid seed that came with the program because it gives better yield than local maize. My family will do most of the work — planting, weeding, and harvesting — but I may hire a few days of ganyu labor when the weeds are heavy or during peak land preparation. We depend entirely on the rains here in Balaka, so there is no irrigation, and I do not waste money on pesticides for a food crop like maize.
